name: Cedric Coward
headline: Cedric Coward is quietly turning his second year into a legit breakout, doing it with rebounds, steals and efficient shooting.
good: He is averaging 14.0 points, 8.7 rebounds, 2.9 assists and 1.6 steals in 29.3 minutes across 7 starts.
The efficiency is excellent: 60.9 percent true shooting and 50 percent from three while using only 18.4 percent of possessions.
Memphis outscores opponents by 12.3 points per game with him on the floor, and he sits at +86 total for the season.
His best recent box score was 23 points, 9 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals on 8 of 19 shooting, with 4 threes.
bad: Foul trouble keeps showing up: he logged 5, 4, 5 and 5 fouls in four of his recent box scores.
He is only a 70 percent free throw shooter and turns it over 1.4 times a game, and his volume is modest at 18.4 percent usage.
Memphis has dropped its last two games, 134-135 to New Orleans and 103-107 to Indiana, after a 6-0 start.
fans: Analysts were already tagging Coward as a second-year breakout candidate, with ESPN's Eric Moody and the NBA GM Survey both mentioning him after an All-Rookie First Team season. Recent coverage says his rebounding limits second-chance points and that he converts his looks far more reliably than last year. Roundtable also reports that scouts see him as a stabilizing force on the roster. I did not find Reddit threads in the search results.
outlook: Coward's grade is an A (86), driven by elite production for his minutes, so expect the role and the numbers to hold. Next up is Oklahoma City at FedExForum on Saturday, Nov 7 (tip is 7 PM CT, per the schedule data). OKC is a 4.5 point favorite and both teams are 6-2, so his defense and rebounding will matter against a strong opponent.
